etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin adjective rītuālis, from noun rītus (“rite”), + adjective suffix -ālis.

definitions.definition: Related to a rite or repeated set of actions.

quote.citation: 2001, David L. Lieber, Jules Harlow, Etz Hayim: Torah and Commentary, page 855:
quote.text: These verses are the basis for the practice of wearing a prayer shawl (tallit) with a ritual fringe (tzitzit) on each of its four corners

definitions.definition: A rite; a repeated set of actions, especially in religious contexts.

quote.citation: 2017, Christine Honders, OCD: The Struggle with Obsessions and Compulsions, page 44:
quote.text: Despite their good intentions, family members who participate in OCD rituals help reinforce the problem.
